description:
UltrafastSecp256k1 for libbitcoin MSVC builds (PlatformToolset v145, x64).
Canonical bridge-free surface: header-only ufsecp::lbtc::* (ufsecp/libbitcoin.hpp)
over the static engine. Optional transparent CUDA acceleration via Option-cuda
(internal math engine; CPU fallback; requires NVIDIA driver at runtime only).
Engagement via Linkage-ultrafast ('' | dynamic | static | ltcg).
summary: UltrafastSecp256k1 canonical libbitcoin integration for MSVC v145
title: UltrafastSecp256k1 (libbitcoin canonical surface, MSVC v145)
